name: dsh-refuse-compaction
description: Refuse-compaction for dsh: intercepts the harness's AUTO-triggered context compaction (step pressure + model-switch pressure; overflow recovery is policy-gated) while manual /compact stays structurally untouched — the preset-scoped engine is resolved via agentPresets.serviceFor and wrapped in place. Four tiers: temporary (block the next 3 turns; auto-switches to manual-ask at >=90% occupancy), manual (block-first ask via an in-conversation bar: compact now / refuse / quiet for 3 turns / stop asking; a busy or failed compact-now is never silently dropped — it approves the next compaction checkpoint, which then runs at the engine's own step boundary), forbid (block all auto compaction), off. v0.2.0 adds an in-conversation occupancy gauge (ring progress + percent/tokens + tier quick-switch, revealed within a configurable fraction of the compaction point); v0.2.1 reads the dsh-compaction-policy row's live config straight from the loader entry tree (zero changes to that plugin) so the gauge follows its effective strategy. Optional linkage with dsh-exa-distill: while distilled digests are pending, pressure compaction is held until the condensed surface lands (95% safety valve).
author: mizuki5101
